_: Who we follow on X. That is the whole X strategy now (mate, 2026-08-23: "just follow ppl, and we will see how it goes"). The reply pipeline that used to read this file is gone — X blocked programmatic replies on 23 February 2026 on every plan below Enterprise, and a copy-and-paste approval page was more of his attention than the idea was worth.
_why: Kept because it is real work, not a listicle: 937 authors read across three discovery sweeps to find these, at about a 5% yield. Without it the next sweep re-derives the same names and re-follows people already followed. Nothing reads it — it is a record, and the follow itself is `zernio twitterengagement:follow-user`, which wants the NUMERIC X id, not the handle.
_who: PEOPLE, never brands — a brand account posts marketing by definition. Everything political, combative, adult, fan-account or tech-adjacent was dropped by hand: a follow is a public statement about what this account is, and X reads it as a topic signal. The audience is people running something small who are not in tech — creators, designers, consultants, voice artists, trainers, small business owners.
